title: Harness snapshot blob
description: A single immutable record of an agent harness composition, stored at .harness/snapshots/<aa>/<rest>.json where <aa><rest> = id. Defined by format.md §2.

formatVersion.description: Optional; defaults to "0.4.0" if absent. v0.4.x writers MAY emit "0.4" (the family default) or a more specific patch like "0.4.0". Major version mismatch is a hard error per format.md §9.

id.description: 40-char lowercase hex content-addressable hash. Derivation: format.md §3.

parentIds.description: Length 0 = init (kind MUST be 'init'); 1 = normal; 2 = merge (reserved, not produced in v0.1).

branch.description: Branch name. Same allowed character set as a git ref (slashes permitted).

codePin.description: Git sha at snapshot time, or null if the project is not a git repository.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC, millisecond precision. MUST end in 'Z'.

model.description: Model id reported by the host on SessionStart (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7'). Optional; absent on snapshots written before the host shipped a model field, or by non-hook writers.

permissionMode.description: Permission mode reported by the host on SessionStart (e.g. 'default', 'plan', 'acceptEdits'). Optional; absent on snapshots written before the host shipped a permission_mode field, or by non-hook writers.

apmLockHash.description: sha256 of apm.lock.yaml bytes at snapshot time, prefixed 'sha256:'. Null when no lockfile present. See apm-integration.md.

apmLockfile.description: Full text content of apm.lock.yaml at capture time. Null when no lockfile present. Captured to enable self-contained reproduction (format.md §6.1). Added v0.4.0; v0.3.x snapshots have this field absent or null.

type.description: Canonical type per format.md §2.2. Writers MUST emit one of: chatmode, instruction, prompt, skill, agent, hook, mcp, style. Readers MUST accept legacy aliases (persona→chatmode, cmd|command→prompt, subagent→agent, tool|server→mcp).

ModuleSource.description: Discriminated union on `kind`. Writers MUST emit one of apm|local|builtin. Readers MUST preserve unknown kinds verbatim on round-trip (forward-compat per format.md §9). Private experiments use `x-`-prefixed kinds — these validate as opaque objects with arbitrary additional properties.

path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path (forward slashes, no leading '/').

oneOf.description: Forward-compat extension: any `kind` matching `^x-`. The validator does not constrain payload shape; readers preserve verbatim and treat as opaque.
